text:
tasha: Heads-up — found a nasty deadlock in the onboarding sample that paginates a large CSV and uploads pages of rows as bulk-embeds. Repro steps below.

omid: deadlock? we were seeing 429 spikes but not deadlocks. what's the reproducer?

tasha: run the sample with these flags: `--page-size=100 --concurrency=8 --batch=64`. The flow: paginator yields page -> client queues up N concurrent bulkCreate calls. When the edge starts returning 429 w/ Retry-After, our SDK semaphore blocks new requests but the paginator still holds goroutines waiting on the semaphore, and retries also requeue to the same semaphore. With certain timing the whole pipeline stalls: no inflight calls, but all workers are waiting on semaphore slots that never free because retries are queued behind the same locked workers.

drew: can you paste the simplified client loop?

tasha: sure:
```js
for await (const page of paginator(csvStream, pageSize)) {
  await semaphore.acquire();
  client.embeddings.bulkCreate({ input: page.rows, batchSize: 64 })
    .then(() => semaphore.release())
    .catch(err => {
       // retry logic that requeues by acquiring the semaphore again
       scheduleRetry(() => client.embeddings.bulkCreate(...))
    });
}
```

omid: oh, I see. The retry scheduler also uses semaphore.acquire(), so a stuck front of queue where retries are blocked behind the paginator can starve the retry path and vice versa. Combined with ignoring Retry-After header for bulk endpoints, you can get stuck because the server expects clients to wait but our internal queue ordering prevents progress.

drew: this is different from simple thundering; it's a starvation/deadlock due to semaphore+retry reentrancy. Nice catch.

devx-bot: created ticket DX-2105 "paginator+semaphore retry deadlock on bulk uploads" assigned to @omid
devx-bot: https://redwood/dx/2105

omid: proposed fixes:
- change semaphore semantics: when acquiring a slot for a batch, decrement by estimateTokens(batch) and treat retries as lower priority so they don't contend unfairly with new page acquires.
- introduce a bounded retry queue separate from the main acquire path so retries don't deadlock with front-line pagination.
- honor Retry-After header for bulk endpoints (both seconds and HTTP-date formats) and prefer server-provided Retry-After over internal backoff when present.
- switch bulk endpoints to full jittered backoff (random_between(0, base*2^attempt)).
- add a small async-yield in paginator when semaphore can't be acquired to let retry queue drain: `await Promise.race([semaphore.acquire(), sleep(50)])` as a temporary mitigation.

harper: for parity, ensure iOS/Android/Go follow same semantics (separate retry queue + honor Retry-After). Also we should document the pitfall in the sample repo's README so integrators don't copy the naive pattern.

tasha: test plan: e2e harness that runs a fake-rate-limit proxy; orchestrate timing so first page gets 429s with Retry-After, ensure retries are honored and pipeline makes forward progress (no stalled workers). Add unit-tests ensuring semaphore counts reflect estimated tokens.

omid: I'll sketch the SDK patch: add RetryManager with two queues (high-priority initial calls, low-priority retries), and update semaphore to consume based on token estimate. Will include instrumentation header X-RW-CLIENT-SLOTS in debug builds.

drew: sample-app change: default onboarding flags to conservative values: page-size=50, concurrency=3, batch=24 and provide RW_ONBOARD_FAST=true for folks who explicitly want speed. Add a short snippet in quickstart explaining the tradeoffs and linking DX-2105.

harper: I'll update docs and include a short example showing correct pattern: use a non-blocking enqueue for retries and respect server Retry-After.

tasha: temporary mitigation for internal QA: set sample's concurrency to 2 and add `--skip-retry` flag to let infra reset. Confirmed that with Semaphore-by-token and honoring Retry-After we no longer hit the deadlock.

omid: good. I'll open the SDK PR and include an integration harness and a changelog entry. Assigning cross-sdk parity follow-ups.

drew: thanks — really valuable find. If anyone sees odd stalls while testing, run with DEBUG=sdk:throttle and attach logs plus the X-RW-CLIENT-SLOTS header values.

tasha: leaving the thread; will paste links to PRs when ready. :rocket:
